content: Screening methods, such as the Oral Glucose Tolerance Test (OGTT), particularly the 75-gram OGTT, are commonly employed to confirm the diagnosis of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM). The diagnostic criteria for GDM have been established by the International Association of Diabetes and Pregnancy Study Groups (IADPSG). These criteria include specific glucose level thresholds that must be met or exceeded during the OGTT to confirm the diagnosis of GDM.
